name: pr-proof
description: Proof that a pull request's change works: record a narrated walkthrough video of the feature against the running app with playwright-recast, from its spec or from requirements reconstructed out of the code, and attach it to the pull request once you accept it.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for the TypeSafe API. Leave empty to read TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

typesafe_endpoint.title: TypeSafe endpoint
typesafe_endpoint.description: Base URL of the TypeSafe API

typesafe_model.title: Jev model
typesafe_model.description: Model name or alias, such as jev-latest or jev-1.14.0

screenshot_widths.title: Screenshot widths
screenshot_widths.description: Comma-separated viewport widths in pixels, such as 375,768,1440. Leave empty to use the project's breakpoints, or 375, 768 and 1440.
